scope: Proposition 3.3 (The seeds) of the manuscript “Ambiently homeomorphic isolated hypersurfaces of multiplicities two and three” (preprints/Ambiently-homeomorphic-isolated-hypersurfaces-of-multiplicities-two-and-three-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 059 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7e450c32aa20ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are real-coefficient weighted homogeneous polynomials p1, p2, each in an even number s0 of variables, such that: 1. both are sums, in disjoint variables, of chains with exponents at least 2, and both have isolated critical points; 2. ord0 p1 = 2 and ord0 p2 = 3; 3. their spectral multisets are equal modulo 2; 4. their real Seifert forms are isomorphic, and, separately, their integral monodromy modules are isomorphic; 5. both monodromy operators have order dividing D = 312.
